changelog:
**Android 17:** needs [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases) canary-3112 or newer. Vector v2.2 stable crashes Google Photos when a module spoofs `android.os.Build`.

**New**
- Home shows whether PixelMask is actually active inside Google Photos, or what failed there.
- **Restart Google Photos** button replaces the trip to the system Force stop screen, which did nothing on some phones.
- *Report — Not working* now includes what the hook did inside Photos, so problems can be pinned down from one report.

**Fixes**
- A failure in the Build spoof no longer stops the feature-flag spoof from running.
